info.description: The Meeting Invitation API enables users to efficiently send invites for meetings, ensuring seamless collaboration across teams. This endpoint allows for the creation of meeting invitations, specifying details such as participants, time, and agenda. Typically used by project managers and event coordinators, this API streamlines the process of scheduling and organizing meetings. By leveraging this service, organizations can enhance communication and optimize their scheduling workload.

post.summary: Send an invitation for a meeting.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to send out invitations to participants for a scheduled meeting. You can include details such as the meeting time, agenda, and participant information to ensure everyone is informed and ready.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send invitations for a meeting. It includes all necessary details about the meeting and the participants who are being invited. Ensure that all the required fields are provided to successfully create meeting invitations.
